title: A proved ticket can be superseded
intention: A ticket standing at PROVED can cross to SUPERSEDED when a later proved ticket replaces it, while a disposition that is an alternative to completing (DROPPED) stays refused from PROVED.
why: Measured 2026-10-08: `cross 481221f45884 SUPERSEDED` refused with "refused: IllegalTransition: PROVED -> SUPERSEDED is illegal for code-seam@v2 (legal from here: ['BUILDME', 'PROVEME', 'THINKME', 'TICKETME', 'WATCHME']) — e.g. a forward skip past a gate summons is refused", though Akien had answered "both look good to me" to exactly that crossing (open-0d44f8905e2e). Peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 as F47, 2026-10-08: "(a) would move a crossing to fit a gate, which is exactly the plaster we don't do. And Akien's yes on open-0d44f8905e2e already settled the spec: a PROVED ticket can be superseded. The door just doesn't offer that crossing yet, so the gate is what's wrong." A proved ticket whose behaviour is retired must be able to say so, or every cursor reader keeps counting it as standing.
traces_to: Law 9 (Akien's head outranks every artifact: his yes on open-0d44f8905e2e settled that a PROVED ticket may be superseded, and the gate is an older translation) and Law 5 (the corpus says what is going on now: a proved ticket whose behaviour was retired must be able to say so, or it reads as standing)
how: In cairn/tools/base/transitions.py legal_targets, add SUPERSEDED (and RETIRED only if Akien picks that option) to the legal targets when the cursor stands at a rest state, beside the existing summons branch; rewrite the standing tooth test_disposition_refused_from_a_rest so PROVED -> DROPPED still refuses and PROVED -> SUPERSEDED lands; reword the tools/base charter line that says a disposition is reachable 'from any summons'. The proof's predict reproduces 481221f45884's exact refusal line on a fixture before the build.

Predict before the build: tooth 1 reds with the exact refusal measured on 481221f45884: "PROVED -> SUPERSEDED is illegal for code-seam@v2 (legal from here: ['BUILDME', 'PROVEME', 'THINKME', 'TICKETME', 'WATCHME'])". Hollow: reverting transitions.py reds tooth 1. Every other test_transitions.py tooth stays green, test_disposition_refused_from_a_rest included (it asserts PROVED -> DROPPED, which stays refused). Horizon: d80360545e91's eighth how step crosses 481221f45884 PROVED -> SUPERSEDED through the real door. Wrong intent if: Akien answers that a proved ticket is never dispositioned.

decisions.text: In cairn/tools/base/transitions.py add a module constant _REST_DISPOSITIONS = ('SUPERSEDED',) beside legal_targets; in legal_targets, directly after the existing 'if is_summons(wf.here): targets.update(dispositions)' branch, add 'elif wf.here not in dispositions: targets.update(dispositions & set(_REST_DISPOSITIONS))' so a rest (a state not ending -ME, e.g. PROVED) gains SUPERSEDED only when the class declares it; change the comment above the summons branch to '# dispositions — reachable from any summons as terminal exits; SUPERSEDED also from a rest'. Nothing else in the file changes.
